newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber closes mostly higher on strike news.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber closes mostly higher on strike news.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed mostly higher, supported by news that British Columbia's coastal forest companies had canceled contract talks with the lumber workers' union, dealers said.
The move came after wildcat strikes at International Forest Products Ltd.
Dealers said, however, that the short-term impact should be minor with supplies of prompt wood currently plentiful.
"There is enough inventory at mills and a secondary level to sustain us unless it is a long strike," one dealer said.
Sept closed up $1.10 at $346.60 per thousand board feet.
Other months closed $1.40 lower to $9.00 higher.
